title: Cat Lovers' ReLooting
description: Datapack removes the string drop from cats and reworks the cat morning gifts.
body:
This pack:

🐾 removes the string drop added in 1.14 (Cats once again drop no items on death.)

🐾 expands the cat_morning_gift table (Note: The chance of receiving Phantom Membrane remains at 1 in 31.)
